display.purpose: Page headings only. Bricolage Grotesque 800 at -0.035em, never below 1.9rem.

section.purpose: Section headings above a hairline rule. Bricolage Grotesque 800 at -0.025em.

card.purpose: Product and post titles. Bricolage Grotesque 700 at -0.015em.

body.purpose: Running copy in Archivo 400 at 0.875rem, measure kept to 60-75 characters.

micro.purpose: Archivo 600, 0.75rem, uppercase at 0.12em. Metadata and control legends; never body copy.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation on interactive cards, and the resting elevation of the two genuinely floating surfaces (garment panel over media, toasts).

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Every transition and reveal in the system. Exponential ease-out from an already-visible default.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The page's one authored reveal: a 14px translate as an element enters, staggered 55ms, transform only. Text never fades or blurs.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: Toast entry: opacity plus a 10px lift at 0.98 scale.

motion.name: badge-pop
motion.purpose: The bag count landing after a mutation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committing action: add to bag, continue to checkout. Ink field, paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:14px 20px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-control, 12px); background:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); color:var(--color-paper, #fff); font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .24s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), transform .24s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--color-ink-soft, #17171a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternate path, such as ordering on WhatsApp. Never competes with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:14px 20px; border:1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e4e4); border-radius:var(--radius-control, 12px); background:var(--color-paper, #fff); color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .24s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), transform .24s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Inverse Button
components.description: A primary-weight action inside an ink band, e.g. the closing order section.
components.css: .ds-btn-inverse { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:14px 20px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-control, 12px); background:var(--color-paper, #fff); color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .24s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-btn-inverse:hover { background:#ededed; } .ds-btn-inverse:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-paper, #fff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Named inputs and selects. Focus swaps the hairline to ink and adds a 3px ink wash.
components.html:
<label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field-demo">Full name</label>
<input id="ds-field-demo" class="ds-field" type="text" placeholder="Ama Mensah">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-muted, #57575c); } .ds-field { width:100%; padding:13px 14px; border:1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e4e4); border-radius:var(--radius-control, 12px); background:var(--color-paper, #fff); color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.875rem; caret-color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); transition:border-color .2s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), box-shadow .2s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--color-muted, #57575c); } .ds-field:hover { border-color:var(--color-line-strong, #c8c8c8); } .ds-field:focus { outline:none; border-color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(11 11 12 / .08); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Uppercase tracked label for badges and state. Five tones: paper, mist, ink, signal, signal-quiet.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:5px 10px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill, 999px); font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; line-height:1; background:var(--color-mist, #f5f5f4); color:var(--color-muted, #57575c); } .ds-chip--ink { background:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); color:var(--color-paper, #fff); } .ds-chip--paper { background:var(--color-paper, #fff); color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(11 11 12 / .12); } .ds-chip--signal { background:var(--color-signal, #c8102e); color:#fff; } .ds-chip--signal-quiet { background:var(--color-signal-soft, #fdeef1); color:var(--color-signal, #c8102e); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: 4:5 media over title, meta and a price row. Hairline at rest; hover gives up the border and takes Lift.
components.html: Best seller Adjoa Silk Slip Dress Silk Series GH₵ 780 Take a size
components.css: .ds-product-card { display:block; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e4e4); border-radius:var(--radius-card, 16px); background:var(--color-paper, #fff); color:inherit; text-decoration:none; transition:border-color .3s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), box-shadow .3s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), transform .3s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-product-card:hover { border-color:transparent; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift, 0 1px 2px rgb(11 11 12 / .05), 0 18px 32px -20px rgb(11 11 12 / .28)); transform:translateY(-3px); } .ds-product-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-product-card__media { position:relative; display:block; aspect-ratio:4/5; background:var(--color-mist, #f5f5f4); } .ds-product-card__media > .ds-chip { position:absolute; top:12px; left:12px; } .ds-product-card__body { display:block; padding:16px; } .ds-product-card__title { display:block; font-family:var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif); font-size:.9375rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.015em; line-height:1.35; color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); } .ds-product-card__meta { display:block; margin-top:6px; font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.75rem; color:var(--color-muted, #57575c); } .ds-product-card__row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-top:12px; } .ds-product-card__price { font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.9375rem; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); } .ds-product-card__action { font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-muted, #57575c); transition:color .3s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-card__action { color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); }

components.name: Shoppable Garment Row
components.description: The signature control inside a feed post: thumbnail, name, cedi price, and a real size choice before Add. A form, so it works with scripting off.
components.html: Adjoa Silk Slip Dress GH₵ 780
components.css: .ds-garment { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:10px; border:1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e4e4); border-radius:var(--radius-control, 12px); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-mist, #f5f5f4) 50%, var(--color-paper, #fff)); font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); } .ds-garment__thumb { width:48px; height:56px; flex:none; border-radius:9px; background:linear-gradient(0deg, var(--color-mist, #f5f5f4), var(--color-mist, #f5f5f4)); } .ds-garment__text { flex:1; min-width:0; } .ds-garment__name { display:block; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); } .ds-garment__price { display:block; margin-top:4px; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); } .ds-garment__form { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex:none; } .ds-garment__size { padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e4e4); border-radius:var(--radius-control, 12px); background:var(--color-paper, #fff); color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); font-family:inherit; font-size:.75rem; } .ds-garment__size:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-garment__add { padding:8px 12px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-control, 12px); background:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); color:var(--color-paper, #fff); font-family:inherit; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .24s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-garment__add:hover { background:var(--color-ink-soft, #17171a); } .ds-garment__add:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); outline-offset:2px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; height:64px; padding:0 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-line, #e4e4e4); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-paper, #fff) 95%, transparent); font-family:var(--font-sans, Archivo, sans-serif); } .ds-nav__wordmark { padding:4px 0; font-family:var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif); font-size:.9375rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.02em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav__links { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px; } .ds-nav__link { padding:8px 0; font-size:.875rem; color:var(--color-muted, #57575c); text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:.25em; transition:color .2s var(--ease-expo, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-nav__link:hover { color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); text-decoration:underline; } .ds-nav__link--active { font-weight:600; color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible, .ds-nav__bag:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav__bag { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:10px; border-radius:var(--radius-control, 12px); font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav__bag:hover { background:var(--color-mist, #f5f5f4); } .ds-nav__count { position:absolute; top:-2px; right:-2px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-width:18px; height:18px; padding:0 4px; border-radius:var(--radius-pill, 999px); background:var(--color-ink, #0b0b0c); color:var(--color-paper, #fff); font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

narrative.northStar: The Shop Window That Behaves Like the Feed
narrative.overview: This is a Ghanaian womenswear storefront whose customers already buy through Instagram and WhatsApp. The interface therefore refuses the category default — a decorative hero above a generic product grid — and instead opens on the brand's own latest post at full feed scale, with the garment taken straight out of it. The catalogue is the feed; browsing is the same gesture the shopper already makes in a chat app. The world is paper and ink: a white field for merchandise, near-black fields for the moments that carry weight, hairline rules instead of boxes, and exactly one saturated colour that is never decoration. Type does the expressive work — a compressed grotesque display voice against a neutral workhorse text face — which is what keeps a two-colour page from reading as a wireframe. Everything visible is placeholder: the brand name, the catalogue, the cedi prices and the photography are illustrative, and the interface says so out loud rather than letting a visitor mistake it for the shop's real offer.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white field, ink-black moments, hairline rules; no third ground.
One signal red, reserved strictly for discount and out-of-stock.
Display type does the expression; the layout stays quiet.
Elevation is declared once per state — a hairline at rest, a single lift on hover.
Placeholder content is labelled as placeholder, in the interface itself.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal red is a fact about money, never a mood. It may mark a discount, a sold-out state, or a destructive action; it may not appear as an accent, a border, an illustration fill, or a brand flourish. A page with no discount shows no red at all.

rules.name: The Two-Grotesque Rule
rules.body: Display is Bricolage Grotesque and text is Archivo; a system display face (Impact, Arial Black, the platform sans) never stands in for the display voice, and the two never swap roles.

rules.name: The Micro Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Nothing functional is set below 0.75rem (12px). Micro labels earn their smallness from uppercase tracking, not from shrinking past legibility.

rules.name: The Above-Above Rule
rules.body: Space above a heading always exceeds space below it: 5rem above a section header, 1rem beneath the heading's rule, 2rem before its content. A heading never floats in the middle of its own section.

rules.name: The Hairline or Lift Rule
rules.body: An element shows a defined edge or a soft elevation, never both. A 1px border sitting under a wide diffuse shadow is the ghost card this system refuses.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: An element nested inside a rounded control takes a smaller radius than its parent (9px inside 12px), so the two curves stay concentric instead of fighting.

rules.name: The Given Size Rule
rules.body: Add to bag always carries a chosen size. A control that adds a garment without one is not allowed; where space is tight, the size selector rides inside the chip rather than being assumed.

dos: Do keep the page field paper-white and the ink fields ink; there is no third ground.
Do draw boundaries with the 1px hairline and reserve shadows for hover and for genuinely floating surfaces.
Do set prices, quantities and stock counts in tabular numerals so columns align.
Do give every interactive element a 2px ink focus ring with a 2px offset, on paper and on ink alike.
Do label illustrative content as illustrative, wherever a visitor could mistake it for the shop's real offer.
Do keep functional text at or above 0.75rem, and interactive targets at or above 24px on both axes.
donts: Don't use signal red as decoration; it belongs to discount, sold-out and destructive actions only.
Don't combine a visible border with a wide diffuse shadow on the same element in the same state.
Don't fade or blur text as an entrance effect — a reader may be mid-sentence when a fade would drop contrast below the floor.
Don't set the display voice in a system font, or swap the two faces' roles.
Don't put a decorative eyebrow or kicker above a heading; the heading carries its own weight and the section rule does the framing.
Don't invent brand assets — no logo, monogram or wordmark exists yet, so the interface uses a neutral placeholder frame and the placeholder name, never a fabricated identity.
Don't present placeholder catalogue, prices or photography as fact.
